public_rationale: Selected reported rounds total $270 billion for OpenAI and Anthropic, which points toward the $266 billion component on an announced-round basis. But OpenAI explicitly calls its major round committed capital. The search did not establish a consistent, deduplicated global total covering exactly January 2023 through September 29, 2026. The full two-part observation therefore remains unresolved; the partial figures do not justify either supporting or contradicting it.
limitations: Funding-round totals and cash receipts are different measures.
Annual and quarterly snapshots do not by themselves provide the exact target-period aggregate.
The selected-round calculation combines reported figures from two data providers.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: About $800 billion in VC has gone into AI companies since 2023, at least $266 billion to Anthropic and OpenAI.

statement.excerpt: I estimate that since 2023, there’s been around $800 billion in global venture capital investment in AI companies, with at least $266 billion of that going to Anthropic and OpenAI.

from_speaker: global venture capital investment in AI companies
our_interpretation: The period runs from January 1, 2023 through publication on September 29, 2026.
The dollar amounts are read as US dollars.

The plain reading is cumulative venture financing into AI companies, including corporate participation in venture rounds. It excludes valuation, revenue, acquisitions, public-market issuance and unrelated borrowing.
Both components must hold: the global total must reasonably approximate $800 billion and the combined Anthropic/OpenAI amount must reach $266 billion.
'Around' allows ordinary rounding but supplies no exact tolerance. A borderline result must not be decided by inventing a favorable or unfavorable tolerance.
'I estimate' is a qualification of the observation, not a conditional antecedent.
Announced round commitments must be distinguished from cash actually received, and overlapping commitments must not be counted twice.
criteria.support_condition: A consistently defined, deduplicated financing dataset for the target period gives a global AI venture total reasonably close to $800 billion and at least $266 billion for Anthropic and OpenAI combined.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently complete dataset on the same basis establishes a global total materially inconsistent with approximately $800 billion, or a combined Anthropic/OpenAI total below $266 billion.
